first_attempt_defect: pdf_to_png tries `sips` before `pdftoppm` and sips ignores the dpi argument, so the 1x/2x/4x/8x sweep produced FOUR BYTE-IDENTICAL copies of the same 150 dpi render (all sha 4ecc8e9df1d1). Its 'PASS' was meaningless and is withdrawn.
reason: no available rasterizer honours the dpi argument, so resolution independence cannot be demonstrated on this host
consequence: §5 forbids running the visual inspections after an unsatisfied raster-stability gate
